channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists solve mystery of brain switch that triggers weight loss in opposite ways
item.description: Researchers have discovered why two opposing methods of targeting the same brain receptor both lead to weight loss, as shown in mouse studies.

item.title: Scientists detect nuclear reactor's ghostly afterglow for first time
item.description: Nuclear reactors may shut down, but their fuel continues emitting a faint antineutrino glow long after. Researchers have now detected this residual radiation.

item.title: Estrogen therapy in later life linked to fewer Alzheimer's brain signs
item.description: Women taking estrogen-only hormone therapy later in life had lower dementia risk and fewer Alzheimer's brain markers.

item.title: Stress hormone may aid brain repair
item.description: A stress-related signal may help the brain heal after injury, as myelin-producing cells respond rapidly.
